limitations: Applies only to the early 24 kWh 48-module 2s2p/module architecture; later Leaf module arrangements differ
300 V loaded floor is a screening assumption, not an OEM discharge cutoff
70% capacity and 80% operating window are example assumptions, not a donor health report
Capacity/SOH does not establish internal resistance, continuous current or regenerative acceptance
Reconfiguration requires independently designed monitoring, contactors, interlocks, insulation and packaging; do not assume the OEM LBC works unchanged
Field weakening/current/thermal and vehicle mass constraints remain unresolved
